head: 6eecf3c3e17e83da4551826430a8f25ad1cb80e4
classification_reasons: Blast radius is large by file count (98 files touched: HANDOFF.md, README.md, docs/ROADMAP.md, docs/OPERATING_MODEL.md, the two stub files, 30 docs/notes/<N>.md, 26 docs/decisions/<N>.md, 21 docs/progress/<...>.md plus three index.md, and the change's own evidence/status files) even though each file's content risk is low and no plugin/template/tests file is touched, so 'few files' does not hold.

The spec is otherwise tight (no open flagged concern left unresolved, measurable acceptance: every citation resolves, indexes list exact counts, build/test/lint stay green), and no risk_list item or schema/contract change is involved, but the sheer surface area and the plan's own extensive Risks section (count drift between sessions 15-18 and build time, naming for non-session PROGRESS records not literally enumerated in spec/plan) are exactly the kind of thing that benefits from a human read rather than being waved through as routine.

No existing automated test exercises this diff (none was expected to: docs-only); the acceptance check is a human/verifier link-resolution pass, not pytest coverage, which also argues against 'routine'.
attempted: Intent: read intent.md's problem/outcome and compared to spec.md/plan.md/the diff; the delivered split (docs/notes, docs/decisions, docs/progress with index.md each, two stubs, four live-doc link updates, CLAUDE.md edit table left for the owner) matches the stated intent exactly, including the deliberate exclusions (docs/BUILD_GUIDE.md, docs/MODEL_ALLOCATION.md, historical docs under docs/handoffs|reviews|proposals).

Spec and plan: checked every Requirements/Design bullet in spec.md and every step of plan.md's Order of work against the diff and the resulting files; verified frontmatter fields by hand on several samples (docs/notes/11.md's 11a/11b/11c subsections stay inside the parent file; docs/notes/30.md's stale_after = generated.at + 90 days computed correctly, 2026-10-03 -> 2027-01-01; docs/notes/11.md's generated.at 2026-09-24 -> stale_after 2026-12-23; decision 18 status:amended/amended_by:21 and decision 21 status:accepted/amended_by:null both match the source text's own labels). The one flagged concern (docs/MODEL_ALLOCATION.md left unedited) is closed with a decision, not left open. Confirmed the four live docs (HANDOFF.md 'Read in this order', docs/ROADMAP.md, docs/OPERATING_MODEL.md, README.md) are the only live docs repointed, and grepped each for a leftover docs/NOTES.md|docs/DECISIONS.md literal path: none found (HANDOFF.md's other old-path mention, in the Session 19 brief paragraph, is a historical/descriptive reference to what the split acted on, not a navigational link the spec scoped for update).

Proof: test.log/build.log/lint.log all carry the '# <command> — deferred to the runner —' header, consistent with a CI build session under the runner mark (plugin 0.3.2 mechanism) and not treated as missing proof per the brief. verifier.md reads the prior gate record and the logs, states 'read, not run', reports no mismatch with plan.md/spec.md, and its own file-count correction (21 archived + index.md = 22) is internally reconciled and matches the diff's --stat count of docs/progress/ files.

Blast radius: diffed --stat confirms no file under plugin/, template/ or tests/ changed, and no guardrail file (.claude/**, CLAUDE.md, REVIEW.md, sdlc.yaml) is touched; hook-log.jsonl (the portion read) shows only 'allow' verdicts, no deny, consistent with the guardrail staying untouched; sdlc.yaml risk_list items (auth, migrations, money, production config) are not implicated by a docs-only move.

Policies: security-baseline/data-conventions not implicated (no secret or PII moved, text is pre-existing platform facts/decisions/session records copied verbatim); ux-conventions explicitly inapplicable (no UI). REVIEW.md's Important criteria (guardrail-file touch, fix-type test tampering, plan/diff mismatch, CLAUDE.md now outdated) all check out clean: change_type is feature not fix, plan.md matches the diff file-for-file, CLAUDE.md's required edits are correctly handed to the owner as a table rather than edited in-session.
Tests: no behavior changed (docs only), so no test could pass or fail differently; verified no plugin/tests file was touched to rule out a disguised code change riding along with the docs move.
